item.title: James Gunn's DCU Is Officially Dead, and That's Good News for Superman Fans
item.description: A popular online joke format in recent months goes something like this: If James Gunn had been in charge of the Marvel Cinematic Universe , what would his first three movies have been?

item.title: Warhammer’s Brutal Fantasy Football Game Just Suffered Another Setback
item.description: Warhammer fans will have to wait a little longer to return to the fantasy football pitch, but the upcoming overhaul is bringing some welcome additions. Warhammer Blood Bowl has been delayed into early 2027, pushing the game's full release out of its previously planned 2026 launch window. Publisher Slitherine announced the delay during its Dominion Days showcase in Berlin, explaining that additional development time is needed to deliver a more polished experience.

item.title: GTA 6 Jacket That Costs $3,000 Immediately Sells Out
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 will be the biggest game of 2026, and Rockstar Games certainly knows it.

item.title: All carpenter locations in Gerudo Fortress in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.description: The Gerudo guards captured four carpenters at Gerudo Fortress in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, and it's Link's job to rescue them. By heading west of Hyrule Field , you will enter Gerudo Valley. If you cross the broken bridge — which you can do by riding Epona — you can talk to the Master Craftsman, who will ask Link to help his apprentices by sneaking into the fortress and releasing them.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Is Scarier Than Ever on Switch 2
item.description: When I first encountered The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time growing up, it scared the crap out of me. The screeching Redeads, the skittering spiders, the disembodied hands — it was basically a horror movie to a young kid’s eyes. I’m older and harder to spook now, of course, which means that I knew the Nintendo 64 game’s fresh Switch 2 remake was bound to hit differently. Surely I’d laugh at everything that used to creep me out and realize that I was scared of a glorified cartoon!

item.title: GTA 6: The Festival Officially Announced by Rockstar
item.description: Rockstar Games is giving Grand Theft Auto 6 fans a unique opportunity to experience the soundtrack to Leonida's chaotic world in real life. On Nov. 21, Rockstar and PlayStation are hosting Grand Theft Auto 6: The Festival, a live music event in Miami, Florida. Tickets are highly exclusive, and only a lucky few will get the chance to acquire them.

item.title: Warhammer 40K’s Highly Anticipated RPG Sets 2027 Release Date
item.description: Developer and publisher Owlcat Games has finally announced a release date for Warhammer 40K: Dark Heresy . The studio's latest game in the Warhammer universe following 2025's Rogue Trader will once again be a CRPG. The game is set to be released on Jan. 28, 2027.

item.title: Target's New 'Pokémon' 30th Anniversary Drawing Is A Must-See For TCG Fans
item.description: Pokémon fans were thrilled to hear about Target's new trading card game raffle system , which gives collectors a fairer chance to secure products against retail bots. The retailer initially debuted the drawing system with a small three-pack of an older Pokémon set, Destined Rivals. Now, however, Target has begun raffling out the type of product fans were hoping for all along: the 30th Anniversary TCG set .

item.title: How to get the Hookshot in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Getting the Hookshot in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is the first and most important thing you do after opening the Door of Time. The Hookshot is essential for reaching the Forest Temple and solving other mandatory puzzles, not to mention reaching harder-to-find collectibles, but the game is quite vague about where to find it. It points you to Kakariko Village, though depending on how thoroughly you investigate, you might miss some of the contextual clues entirely.

item.title: All amiibo rewards and drops in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Being a Nintendo Switch 2 game, of course, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake has amiibo functionality . After you progress in the game, you can toggle the amiibo option in your settings, allowing you to scan in your various Zelda franchise amiibo for some rewards.
